title: Gourmet Champions [ Random Cooking ]
description: cooking race mod where players compete with randomized food goals
body:
## 📖 What This Mod Does?
This mod adds a random cooking competition system where players race to complete food objectives as fast as possible.

When a match starts, players receive a set of random food tasks. They must gather resources, craft the required foods, and complete all objectives before anyone else.

The first player to finish wins the game.

### ✨ Features
- Random food objective system every match
- Fast-paced multiplayer cooking competition
- In-game tracking for all required foods
- Supports food items from other mods
-  Highly replayable with different outcomes each round

### 🍖 Mod Compatibility
Works great with food mods, especially [Farmer's Delight Refabricated](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated) and its addons.
The more food mods you use, the more variety and chaos each match becomes.

### 📥 Installation
Minecraft Version: Fabric 1.20.1

Server-side required, client-side recommended for full experience.

### 🏁 How to Play
- Start a match using the game command
- Players vote ready (Apply system)
-  Everyone is teleported and inventory reset
-  Race to complete all food objectives
- First to finish wins instantly

### 💬 Commands

- `` /randomfood start `` – Start match
- `` /randomfood start <number> ``– Start with custom objective count
- `` /randomfood stop `` – Stop match
- `` /randomfood reload `` – Reload config
- `` /randomfood setting  `` – Open settings menu
